sources.snippet: Home Pipeline Tutorials OCR PaddleOCR-VL Introduction PaddleOCR-VL is a SOTA and resource-efficient model tailored for document parsing. Its core component is PaddleOCR-VL-.9B, a compact yet powerful vision-language model (VLM) that integrates a NaViT-style dynamic resolution visual encoder with the ERNIE-4.5-0.3B language model to enable accurate element recognition. sources.snippet: PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 is a new iterative version of the PaddleOCR-VL series. Based on comprehensive optimization of the core capabilities of version 1.0, the model achieves 94.5% accuracy on the authoritative document parsing benchmark OmniDocBench v1.5, surpassing top global general-purpose large models and document parsing-specific models.
